note: FNS 726.5 is primarily a QC review procedure section, not a caseworker policy requirement. It instructs QC reviewers on how to treat unreported income at recertification as an 'includable variance for error determination purposes,' how to handle Comparison II calculations, and that there is no exclusionary period for income incorrectly reported at recertification. These are audit/QC methodology concepts with no caseworker equivalent. The one underlying policy element — that simplified reporting households must report all income at recertification — IS covered by the OLG. The 'Simplified Reporting – Overview' page states: 'Simplified Reporting clients are only required to report changes outside of application, Interim Report (IR) and Recertification periods if their monthly gross income exceeds the limit.' The 'Simplified Reporting – Examples' page confirms: 'All Simplified Reporting households must report and verify income at application and recertification.' The 'Simplified Reporting – Recertification' page covers the full recertification process including verification of income. The QC-specific content (variance classification, error determination methodology, exclusionary period rules, Comparison II calculations) is directed at QC reviewers and has no analog in caseworker guidance.
